node.title: hankel rank profile entropy
node.statement: The rank-profile dichotomy: row-deficient Hankel kernels are principal GRS segments (binary apolarity; verified 4000/4000); row-full wide states have one atom-closure; row-full narrow states have dim O(W). Hence unpaid primitive saturated states number n^{O(W^2)} for fixed cutoff W — L3 via the entropy/Kraft argument. Write-up + the classical apolar lemma pending.
node.notes: PROVED on replay (rounds 7-8): the corrected torus lemma (falsification #19 was MY v7 statement — Pro found the boundary counterexample AND supplied the referee-grade corrected proof); 5086/5086 verified incl. 2966 boundary cases.
